subject: Vendor summary doc
text: Hey, sorry this is all over the place, but I need the vendor summary doc, or at least the part with the updated renewal terms. I asked yesterday maybe, maybe not, because my notes are a mess, and I think the file got buried under the budget screenshots. Wait, did I send you the draft? The attachment was missing again, I know, I keep doing that, but this time I genuinely think I forgot to hit add. Anyway, if you already have the current version, could you forward it? If not, any notes from the finance meeting would also help, especially anything about the storage fees changing, because that line keeps confusing me and I do not want to put down the wrong number in the client prep. Also sorry if this is late, I meant to write earlier but then got pulled into the planning call. I do not need the whole packet, just the pages on renewal, pricing, and that odd clause about access hours. Let me know whenever you can, no huge emergency, but I would like to check before the afternoon if possible. Oh, and if the doc is in the shared folder, a link is fine, honestly, whatever is easiest. I tried looking earlier but the folder names still confuse me, especially the one with the backup copies, or maybe that is the archive, I cannot remember. No need to reformat anything, I just need to glance at the dates and make sure I am not repeating the thing from last quarter.
